description: Source code for the Broadcast class in Apache Spark, defining an abstract class for broadcast variables with methods for managing their lifecycle and access.

classes.name: Broadcast
classes.description: An abstract class representing a broadcast variable in Spark, providing methods for access, unpersisting, and destroying the broadcast data.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the broadcasted value after asserting validity.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Asynchronously unpersists the broadcast variable from executors.

methods.name: unpersist
methods.description: Unpersists the broadcast variable, with an option to block until completion.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the broadcast variable, making it unusable.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the broadcast variable with an option to block until complete.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the broadcast variable is still valid and usable.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Abstract method to get the broadcasted value, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: doUnpersist
methods.description: Abstract method to unpersist the broadcast data on executors.

methods.name: doDestroy
methods.description: Abstract method to destroy broadcast data and metadata.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Checks if the broadcast is valid; throws an error if it has been destroyed.
